Hi Jill —

Thanks again for the time earlier. As discussed, I attached a lightweight MAP template and a short weekly-checklist PDF to make the initial evaluation runway explicit (owners, success criteria, tech gates, and a two-week cadence for demos). The goal: get to a 30-day pilot acceptance with clear technical validation steps and a procurement path.

What I shared:
- MAP-template-v1.gdoc (editable) — outlines stakeholders, milestone dates, acceptance criteria, and risk register.
- MAP-weekly-checklist.pdf — a compact one-pager for your weekly syncs.

Quick asks:
1) Can you share which engineer(s) from your side will own the PoC verification so we can add them to the doc?
2) Do you have any procurement constraints (standard T&Cs, required security artifacts) we should surface on the timeline?
3) If the week-of July 6 works, we propose a 30-minute technical kickoff — I can send a calendar invite once you confirm owners.

Link to editable draft: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcDeF-map-template-v1
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/5490

Attachments: MAP-template-v1.gdoc (Google Doc), MAP-weekly-checklist.pdf (PDF)

Thanks — looking forward to your notes.

Thanks, Jill — and hi Michael / Priya, glad to meet you over email. I've pushed a short 'owners & gates' section to the MAP draft (link below) where I've added placeholder owners for the integration test, latency baseline, and privacy checklist. Marissa and Ben are cc'd to coordinate the demo and infra prep.

Immediate plan:
- July 7, 10:00 AM ET — 30m technical kickoff (I'll send invite once Michael confirms)
- Week 1 objectives (engineering): integration token flow, sample input validation, baseline latency measurement (we'll capture 95th percentile sample).
- Week 2 objectives: quality checkpoints, prompting experiments, basic cost/throughput profiling.

Proposed acceptance criteria (short):
- Successful end-to-end inference on a representative dataset (sample size ~100 requests)
- Latency within agreed SLO (95th < 800ms for 512 tokens)
- No PII leakage based on the shared prompt set and initial eval tests

Attachments: initial-map-slides.pptx (2-slide deck with milestone dates & owners)
Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcDeF-map-template-v1

Michael — can you confirm the dev who should own the integration work? If July 7 works I will lock the invite.

Nice framing, team. A couple quick suggestions after a read-through of the MAP-template-v1 draft:

1) Move the "procurement gating" row earlier in the milestones table (week 0) so legal/procurement have a single visible checkpoint. That will reduce surprise delays.
2) Add a short acceptance-test checklist item for the customer-side instrumentation (e.g., a health endpoint that returns model version and token-rate).

I've uploaded a 2-slide stub (initial-map-slides.pptx) with a simple heatmap view of milestone risk and proposed owners. If everyone is aligned we should:
- Finalize the MAP doc by July 9
- Run weekly 30-minute check-ins (Thursdays 10:00 AM ET) for the duration of the pilot

Hannah / Ben — I'll take point on the demo cadence and will prep the first demo script; Ben please confirm you'll be the technical presenter for week 1.
